articles.title: Watch Venus Play Hide-and-Seek Behind the Moon!
articles.summary: On June 17, the Moon will slide right in front of Venus for some lucky skywatchers. It’s called a lunar occultation, and Venus will vanish for a while before popping back out. If you’re in the U.S., Canada, Brazil, or Venezuela, don’t miss it!

articles.title: A Giant Wave of Warm Water Is Heading Toward South America—And It Could Shake Up Our Weather!
articles.summary: A satellite spotted a huge, warm wave moving across the Pacific Ocean. It’s called a Kelvin wave, and it’s a sign that an El Niño might be coming. El Niño can change weather all over the world, bringing floods to some places and droughts to others.

articles.title: Mystery Solved! We Finally Know What’s Sending Those Weird Radio Signals From Space
articles.summary: Astronomers found the source of strange, repeating radio bursts: a white dwarf star stealing gas from a red dwarf. The pair, called ASKAP J1745−5051, orbits every 1.4 hours and acts like a cosmic lighthouse, beaming radio waves our way.
